Counts describe executed cases and reported checks. Fixture modes repeat cases; no combined unique-feature or unique-test total is asserted.
Non-counter checks, scenario counts, source-file counts and migration units are retained separately. Reports without fail/skip counters do not establish such formal totals.

Database authorization and migration suites use local PGlite with synthetic managed Auth, Storage and Vault. They do not establish hosted PostgreSQL/PostgREST compatibility, production migration acceptance, deployed provider delivery or real-user journeys.
PGlite serializes queries; these runs do not establish multi-backend lock/deadlock performance or production concurrency latency.
Notification-event and downstream business/music candidates remain source-only or held on QA. Local fixture installation does not activate them on QA or production.
No hosted database writes, migration retries, source publication or production changes were performed by these local runs.
